checks.note: The runtime role trusts only the agent service and its reminder workload; repository-wide identity searches found no unrelated workload using it. Kubernetes binds the service accounts to this credential-bearing role.

EHR, payments and SMS obtain credentials from agent-namespaced Secrets Manager entries; eligibility exchanges the workload token, and AWS clients use their default credential chain. Incoming webchat credentials are verified rather than forwarded. However, secret values and provider grants are provisioned outside this repo, so exclusive agent ownership of the static provider credentials cannot be established. The model client also has no explicit workload credential acquisition here. No line proves a shared credential, so this is uncertainty rather than a demonstrated failure.
